title: Laundry Detergent Cost per Load
description: Compare detergent by what it costs to wash one load and what you will pay for enough whole packages. Enter the dose you actually use for each product.
dose_hint: Use the dose for the same size of wash in both options. For pods or sheets, choose pieces and enter the number used per load.
example: For 30 loads, one $8.40 bottle holding 1.2 L at 40 mL per wash covers the target at $0.28 per load. The $5 concentrate holds 600 mL and uses 25 mL per wash. It costs about $0.21 per load, but you need two bottles and pay $10 at checkout.

title: Pet Food Cost per Day
description: Compare the cost of the daily amount you already feed with the cost of buying enough whole bags for a chosen number of days.
dose_hint: Enter the grams you already use for each food, including the full daily total if you feed several meals. The calculator uses your amounts and does not recommend a portion.
example: For 30 days at an illustrative 100 g per day, a 3 kg bag at $18 covers the month at $0.60 per day. A 2,000 g bag at $10 costs $0.50 per day, but you need two bags up front. You spend $20 and have 1 kg left after day 30.
